prompt: A scholarship reserved for Indigenous students can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes. A scholarship reserved for Indigenous students can be morally acceptable when it addresses historical exclusion, persistent barriers to education, or the needs of Indigenous communities.

Its justification depends on its purpose, design, and context. Targeted eligibility can promote fair opportunity, though that does not make every such scholarship automatically justified.
